title: Lonefield Evacutation Survivor
description:
Lonefield Evacuation Survivor is a... survivor in which you play as a ship facing an alien incursion. Destroy your enemies, collect bolts and upgrade your ship to survive long enough and escape. Play alone or with your up to 3 friends in local multiplayer or with Remote Play Together.

 

Play alone or with up to 3 friends

You can play alone. Or you can play with up to 3 friends on a local multiplayer. And if you want to play online, don’t worry, this game is compatible with Remote Play Together.

Sectors & stages

This game is organized with sectors which includes 4 stages each. Corresponding to boards and levels. 

 

The AI

It will help you along the way. Listening to its calls will help you for sure.

 

Destroy aliens

Hordes of aliens will rush you, shoot you, surround you. But you have many ways to get stronger and kills them all. Or at least, survive long enough for the extraction portal.

 

Survive long enough

When you launch a game, you must survive until the extraction portal is charged. When it appears, you can escape and win.

 

Collect bolts & upgrade

Alien drop bolts when you kill them. As you loot them, you fill up your upgrade bar. When it’s full, you earn an upgrade and get stronger!

 

Collect golden bolt & apply retouch

You can collect golden bolts by secret ways or by winning stages. Then, you can use them in the Ship shed, apply retouch on the ship and make them stronger from one stage to another.
